sources.organization: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
sources.title: Crop Innovation & Tech Transfer
sources.reference: Department mandate, page sections at lines 8-12 of the accessed page; no crop-specific rule extracted
sources.geographic_scope: Rwanda-wide institutional mandate; no district-level recommendation scope stated
sources.source_authority: Rwandan agriculture research and technology-transfer authority
sources.intended_use: Source discovery and authority context only; not itself a farmer recommendation
sources.reuse_status: unknown; confirm applicable terms before redistribution
sources.reviewer_notes: The page describes RAB crop research, extension delivery, and good agricultural practice training. It does not provide the crop-specific values needed to validate CropPulse rules.

sources.organization: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
sources.title: RAB launches Rwanda Digital Soil Information System to improve agricultural productivity
sources.reference: Article paragraphs 2-3 (RwaSIS purpose, crops and testing status)
sources.geographic_scope: Rwanda; described as location-specific, soil-UPI based service; no downloadable district rules in this article
sources.intended_use: Records RwaSIS scope and the reported status at launch; not a source of numeric recommendations
sources.reuse_status: link attribution allowed by reference; reuse of underlying RwaSIS data not established
sources.reviewer_notes: The announcement says potato and rice fertilizer recommendations were complete at launch, while final tests for maize, wheat, cassava and beans were still ongoing. Verify current status and obtain applicable source data directly before use.

sources.organization: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
sources.title: Rwanda Soil Information System (RwaSIS)
sources.reference: Portal landing page; page content was not readable by the inspection tool
sources.geographic_scope: Rwanda service; detailed data coverage not independently inspected
sources.intended_use: Potential future access to soil-specific evidence after data, scope, and permissions are confirmed
sources.reuse_status: unknown; contact RAB before extraction, integration, or redistribution
sources.reviewer_notes: No data, recommendation values, API, export format, or permission terms were accessed in this implementation. Do not infer portal contents from its existence.

sources.title: Climate Services for Agriculture
sources.reference: Page sections ‘Climate Services for Agriculture’ and ‘Key forecasts that are relevant to Agriculture’
sources.geographic_scope: Rwanda agency service; specific forecast products must retain their own issue date, valid period, and geography
sources.intended_use: Dated weather and climate context only; not validation of crop suitability, fertilizer rates, or pest treatment rules
sources.reuse_status: confirm data-product terms and permission before redistribution or commercial use
sources.reviewer_notes: The page describes short-, medium-, seasonal and inter-annual agricultural climate services. No forecast values were ingested by this source registry.

sources.organization: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
sources.title: NISR SAS district crop area and production, 2023-2026
sources.reference: data/verified/MANIFEST.json and data/verified/nisr_sas_2023_2026.csv; source workbook and table references are recorded per row in the manifest
sources.geographic_scope: District aggregates; 2023-2025 Seasons A/B/C and 2026 Seasons A/B, as stated in the manifest
sources.intended_use: Historical area and production statistics and descriptive yield context only; never a crop-management rule
sources.reuse_status: preserved from existing project manifest; confirm terms for external redistribution
sources.reviewer_notes: This existing dataset is not copied into the agronomic rules registry. It does not establish farm suitability, causal yield effects, input rates, or treatments.
